# InstantRupiya

> InstantRupiya is a digital lending platform operated under Aarsh Fincon Limited, an RBI-registered Non-Banking Financial Company (Registration No. B-10.00119). The website provides personal loan information, application access, repayment guidance, and financial planning tools.

## Important
Loan approval, interest rates, fees, repayment terms, and disbursal decisions are determined by the applicable regulated lender. Review the final loan agreement and disclosures before accepting an offer.
